reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of working with Jorge, who provided an excellent quote for new ductwork to replace my outdated box system. He took the time to explain every detail, and his pricing was very competitive. The crew that came out to do the installation was professional and efficient, making the entire process seamless. I am truly impressed and will definitely be recommending your services to my neighbors and friends. Moving forward, I will be relying on you for all my HVAC needs!

Our experience with Mondragon Mechanical was amazing from beginning to end. From the first person I spoke to, Kimberly to the professional & knowledgeable technicians who were able to replace our AC and Furnace. They definitely understood our frustration with our old unit and were able to install right away. I would recommend Mondragon Mechanical to everyone, Thank you again!
A real pleasure working with Mondragon and their staff. Prices are fair but their customer service is perfect. I will be recommending them to anyone who needs this type of service.

I was replacing a cheap unit home warranty installed just 10 years ago that was undersized and poorly installed.

The guys at Mondragon did a clean install; they took their time ensuring all parts were properly fitted and at the end cleaned up to the point you couldn’t tell they were even here.

Mondragon has always taken care of me.  They have great prices and friendly staff.  My technician, Bryan, was very knowledgeable and patient with all my questions.  I’ve referred a couple people to them and both were very satisfied with Mondragon’s service.

I had a new carrier unit installed this week. Kimberly was really sweet and helpful throughout the process. She gave me a good price, answered all my questions. The guys who came to install were very thorough and willing to answer my questions. We passed Frisco city inspection today! Thank you Kimberly and your team! I will be recommending this company to everyone!! The process was very easy, unlike other companies I have had to deal with in the past!

Furnace replacement and new ducting. Great experience working with Mondragon Mechanical from start to finish. They were honest knowledgeable and dependable! I would highly recommend with no reservation!

These guys were great throughout the whole process. Jacob was very helpful and informative when it came to determining the right units and system for my house, and was forthright on pricing and what to expect. The installers were professional, friendly, and kept my house clean while doing all their work. I would highly recommend Mondragon for any HVAC issues!

I purchased a whole new inside and outside unit last year. I’ve recently had issues with it not blowing as cold air as before, i had them come out to check on it and turns out, either they left the coolant low when installing or it has a leak.. mind you think is a whole new unit i paid $8,500. Now they said it’s not their fault and i have to pay an additional $360 to fix? this is ridiculous! Do not purchase here they leave things half done and then try to get more money to get it fixed.

This is my fourth time working with Jorge at Mondragon Mechanical and there is a reason why I keep coming back. He has always delivered top class at best price I could find anywhere. This time he installed 3 ton 18 seer variable speed system. Weather protection cap surge protector UV sleeves New plenum new tray with moisture sensor was all included. So happy and I just wish they keep this honest way of doing business going so I never have to worry about finding another HVAC company.

Reached out when my external unit stopped working and Mandragon was very responsive, professional and courteous. Kimberly assisted fast and scheduled a visit, they came asap and replaced my compressor. I will use them again and recommend their services.

I was in a tough situation and Kimberly pulled a team together to get me out of my jam.  Javier and his team were respectful of our home and got the work done.  Mondragon is a phenomenal group and I would recommend them hands down.  It was amazing how quickly they were able to come out and fix everything the other group messed up.  I cannot thank Kimberly and Javier enough!  Thank you!

Their team was prompt, professional, and highly knowledgeable. The technician quickly diagnosed the issue and completed the repair efficiently. It's clear they take pride in their work and prioritize customer satisfaction. I highly recommend them for anyone needing reliable mechanical or HVAC services.

Jorge and staff are very efficient and organized. Always does what they say they are going to do. Old fashion integrity to sum it all up. Highly recommend their professional services to whom is in need.

Jorge is my go to person for all AC install needs. He is amazing in providing great quality at best price. Called him in evening one day, next day evening two units installed and working perfectly. This is my second install for my home and referred him to friends. Not even a single complaint.I plan to call him next time I have need. Greatly recommended
